spans.s: म्लक्ष् vt. 10U (pres. म्लक्षयति-ते) To cut, to divide.
म्लान a. (f. ना) 1. Faded, withered; 2. sad, dejected, melancholy; 3. wearied; 4. languid, feeble, weak; 5. foul, dirty.
म्लान a. (f. ना) 1. Faded, withered; 2. sad, dejected, melancholy; 3. wearied; 4. languid, feeble, weak; 5. foul, dirty.
म्लान-अंगी f. a woman during the menses.
म्लानि f. 1. Decay, withering; 2. sadness, dejection; 3. weariness, lassitude; 4. foulness.
म्लास्नु a. 1. Growing lanquid; 2. growing thin; 3. growing withered.
